title: Jonah and the Visitor
author: Lior Voss
blurb: Sable Nakamura, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
